{{Top|leg}}
'''The Stones''' was a residential area located in the south-east part of [[Iritsa]] on [[Chazwa/Legends|Chazwa]]. It consisted of low buildings constructed of red and gray stone. It was mainly populated by the wealthy [[Stones-dweller|Stone-dwellers]]. The pathways were well-maintained but not nearly as crowded as the rest of the city was.
